dossier.scp_unleashed.024.title: Game Show of Death
dossier.scp_unleashed.024.caption: SCP-024 as first sighted: a vacant warehouse, front doors facing the reader.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-024 cannot be moved, damaged or sealed. A perimeter is to be marked around the warehouse, and its front doors are to be watched from a distance.
**No one is to open the front doors.** Personnel who go through them are to be considered contestants until they return.
Prizes recovered from returning contestants are to be logged and stored. None has shown any value of any kind.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-024 is a plain single-storey warehouse of corrugated metal and stained concrete, with a loading dock and a faded painted sign. It appears once, close to someone who has read this file, somewhere they were not looking. No second building has been seen.
No tool, blast or flood has marked its walls, roof or doors. The front entrance is a pair of large glass doors, and behind the glass there is only darkness. Light does not reach it.
Anyone who opens the doors arrives on a lit stage in an endless dark space. A host in a sharp suit greets them, his face lost in spotlight glare above the mouth. He calls it the Game Show of Death.
Contestants are put through games of skill and nerve. Six wins open an exit back to the warehouse doors. A loss is fatal. %rThe studio audience has never been seen.%r

page.title: Addendum 024-1: Prize Log
page.text: Items recovered from survivors: one block of dirt, one stick, one wheat seed, a dead bush, rotten flesh, a flint pebble and a large number of small bundles of doll hair, which the host calls Doll Hairs. Every survivor also received a ribbon reading PARTICIPANT. Value: none.

page.title: Addendum 024-2: Interview
text: Survivor: "He never stops smiling. You can't see his eyes, just the light. After the sixth game he shook my hand and said I'd be back."
The survivor has asked that the dirt be returned to him. %rRequest denied.%r

death.attack.scp_unleashed.scp024_elimin: %1$s was eliminated from the Game Show of Death
%1$s was eliminated from the Game Show of Death while fighting %2$s
death.attack.scp_unleashed.scp024_blast: %1$s went out with a bang on live television
%1$s went out with a bang on live television, courtesy of %2$s
game.scp_unleashed.scp024.pillar_hop.rul: Pillar Hop! Hop across the glowing pillars to the golden platform at the far end. Below you is nothing at all. We checked.
You have 90 seconds. Fall, and you are off the show. Run out of time, and the pillars go home without you.
game.scp_unleashed.scp024.shooting_galle: Shooting Gallery! Our marksmen are tucked into the walls, and you are the target. Hide behind the cover and keep moving.
Survive for 45 seconds and you win. More marksmen join every ten seconds. They are very keen.
game.scp_unleashed.scp024.fighting_pit.r: The Fighting Pit! Three waves of very motivated guests are coming to say hello. We lent you a sword and a shield. Use them.
Clear all three waves within 150 seconds. The show keeps the sword. The show always keeps the sword.
game.scp_unleashed.scp024.rising_lava.ru: Rising Lava! Climb the spiral steps to the golden ledge at the top. In five seconds the floor gets very, very warm.
The lava rises one step every second and a half. If it reaches your eyes, it is over. Climb!
game.scp_unleashed.scp024.crumbling_floo: Crumbling Floor! Every tile you stand on crumbles away a moment later. Below the floor is the void. Keep moving!
Last 45 seconds on what is left. After fifteen seconds, the floor starts crumbling all by itself. Isn't that fun?
game.scp_unleashed.scp024.anvil_rain.rul: Anvil Rain! Anvils fall from the rafters. Watch the floor for red rings: that is where they land. Do not be there.
Survive for 40 seconds. The anvils come faster and faster, and some of them are aimed at you. Helmets help!
game.scp_unleashed.scp024.maze_run.rules: Maze Run! You start in one corner of the maze. The exit is the gold tile in the far corner, marked by green sparkles.
You have 75 seconds to find it. When time runs out, the floor of the maze has somewhere else to be.
game.scp_unleashed.scp024.memory_tiles.r: Memory Tiles! Watch the tiles light up, then step on them in the same order. Three rounds: three steps, then four, then five.
You may make one mistake, and we replay the round. Make two and you go down with the tile. 120 seconds on the clock!
game.scp_unleashed.scp024.quiz_show.rule: Quiz Show! Read the question on the board, then press the red, yellow or blue button for answer A, B or C.
Get three right and you win. Get one wrong, or run out of time, and the trapdoor under you opens. 15 seconds a question!
Door Roulette! Three curtained doors. One hides the way forward. The other two hide a little surprise. Click a door to open it.
Pick the right door three rounds in a row. Wrong doors go boom and get barred shut. You have 75 seconds!
game.scp_unleashed.scp024.tnt_dodge.rule: Blast Dodge! Our cannons lob fizzing charges onto the floor. Each one blows a second and a half after it lands.
Watch for the red rings and stay out of them for 45 seconds. They aim at you more often as time runs out.
game.scp_unleashed.scp024.arrow_corridor: Arrow Corridor! Get to the golden floor at the far end. The wall traps click just before they fire, row by row.
Time your runs and wait in the alcoves. You have 60 seconds. Shields are allowed, cowardice is encouraged.
game.scp_unleashed.scp024.minefield.rule: Minefield! Cross to the golden row. Some plates hide mines. Safe tiles change colour to count the mines touching them.
White means none, then green, yellow, orange and red for more. Each mine you find finds you back. 90 seconds!
game.scp_unleashed.scp024.ice_bridge.rul: Ice Bridge Race! Slide along the winding ice bridge to the golden platform. Six seconds after the start, it begins to fall away behind you.
It is slippery, it is narrow, and the void is patient. You have 40 seconds. Mind the corners!
game.scp_unleashed.scp024.sumo_ring.rule: Sumo Ring! Stay on the ring for 45 seconds. Our wrestlers hit softly but shove very, very hard.
We lent you a Sumo Paddle with a mighty knockback. Push them off before they push you off!
Champion Bout! You face our reigning Champion, in iron, undefeated, and very proud of it. Sword and shield provided.
Defeat the Champion within 90 seconds. Block with your shield. The Champion does not.
game.scp_unleashed.scp024.silverfish_esc: Silverfish Escape! The vents behind you are full of silverfish, and they are hungry. Run for the golden floor at the far end.
Hurdles, a pit and tight turns stand in your way. You have 40 seconds. Some of them may be waiting ahead.
game.scp_unleashed.scp024.lights_out.rul: Lights Out! Somewhere in this dark room is a faintly glowing gold exit tile, in one of the four corners. Find it.
Something else is in here with you, and it can see in the dark. You have 60 seconds. Listen carefully.
game.scp_unleashed.scp024.hot_floor.rule: Hot Floor! Tiles glow orange, then turn to magma. Magma burns, even if you sneak. Keep to the cool tiles.
Survive for 40 seconds. Hot tiles cool again after a while, and new ones love to appear near you.
game.scp_unleashed.scp024.shrinking_aren: Shrinking Arena! Every few seconds the outer ring turns red and drops into the void. Stripes fall too, so watch the orange.
Stay on the floor for 45 seconds. At the end there is very little floor left. Get comfortable.
game.scp_unleashed.scp024.hot_potato.rul: Hot Potato! You are holding a fizzing charge. Right-click the glowing pedestal to pass it off before it goes off.
It comes back to you every time. Pass it six times to win. If it blows in your hands, it really hurts. 120 seconds!
Parkour Time Trial! Jump, climb and balance your way along the course to the golden platform at the far end.
Fall into the net and you start again from the top. You have 75 seconds in total. The clock does not wait.
game.scp_unleashed.scp024.target_practic: Target Practice! Targets pop up on the far wall and on the posts. Shoot ten of them with the bow we lent you.
Each target only stays up for four seconds. You have 60 seconds, and we keep you stocked with arrows.
game.scp_unleashed.scp024.wheel_of_misfo: Wheel of Misfortune! I spin the wheel, the wheel picks a hazard, and you survive it for twenty seconds. Simple!
Anvils, blasts, arrows, zombies, hot floors or silverfish. Every segment is a winner. For us.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp024.welcome.0: Well, HELLO there, contestant! Welcome, welcome, WELCOME to the Game Show of Death! Give yourself a hand, nobody else will!
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp024.welcome.1: The rules are simple! Play a game. Win the game. Collect a fabulous prize! Lose the game and, well, we never film that part.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp024.welcome.2: Survive SIX games and that lovely door behind you opens. Six! It's less than seven! You can do it! Statistically, you cannot.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp024.welcome.3: No digging, no building, no pouring, no running off with pearls. The show provides everything you need. Except mercy.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp024.welcome.4: Our studio audience is on the edge of their seats! Probably. It's very dark out there. Let's play!
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp024.announce.0: Round %s! Spin up the lights, folks, it's time for %s!
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp024.announce.1: Round %s, and what a round it is! Our contestant will now play %s!
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp024.announce.2: Round %s! The audience voted, and they chose... %s! They always choose that.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp024.announce.f: Round %s, the FINAL round! One more game between you and the door. It's %s!
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp024.ready.0: Ready? It doesn't matter! Off you go!
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp024.ready.1: Any last words? Save them for the prize! Places, please!
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp024.ready.2: Good luck! You'll need it. Everybody does. Let's go!
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp024.win.0: WINNER! Round %s goes to our contestant! Look at that, still in one piece!
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp024.win.1: They did it! Round %s is in the bag! The producers are furious!
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp024.win.2: Ladies and gentlemen, round %s is WON! Give it up for the survivor!
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp024.drumroll: And for your fabulous prize... drumroll, please... you have won...
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp024.progress: That's %s down and %s to go! Back to the stage, superstar!
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp024.progress.l: That's %s down and just %s to go! One more and that door is yours!
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp024.finale.0: SIX! Six wins! Ladies and gentlemen, we have a SURVIVOR! I genuinely did not see that coming!
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp024.finale.1: Your grand prize: a Participation Ribbon and %s whole Doll Hairs! You participated! Look at you!
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp024.finale.2: The exit door is lit. Off you go, before the producers notice. Come back soon! You will.
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.near.1: The audience gasps! Or that was the wind.
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.near.2: Careful! The cleaning crew charges extra.
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.near.3: That one nearly had your name on it!
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.near.4: Whoa there! Keep it together, champ!
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.near.5: Ha! Too close for comfort. Mine, I mean.
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.hurt.0: Getting a little red there, champ!
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.hurt.2: You are leaking hearts. It's very dramatic.
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.hurt.3: Hang in there! Literally, if you can.
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.time.0: Ten seconds! Nine! I cannot count any faster!
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.time.1: The clock is not your friend!
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.wrong.0: Bzzt! Wrong! One more and it's curtains.
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.wrong.1: Oh no no no. Let's see that again, shall we?
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.wrong.3: That tile was not on the list!
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.zonk.0: ZONK! Behind that door: a lovely little explosion!
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.zonk.1: Ooh, wrong door! Have you tried the other ones?
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.mine.0: Found one! Well, it found you.
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.mine.1: Boom! That's one way to count mines.
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.mine.2: The numbers were trying to warn you!
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.blast.1: You were supposed to pass it!
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.blast.2: That's the fizz I warned you about!
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.eliminated.0: And that's elimination! Thanks for playing!
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.eliminated.1: Oh, rotten luck! Mind the drop!
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.eliminated.2: So long, contestant! Wave to the cameras!
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.eliminated.3: Eliminated! Don't worry, the floor knows the way.
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.resume.1: The show must go on! Again!
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.lucky.0: Ooh, that was close to the fuse!
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.lucky.1: Just in time! The crowd goes wild!
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.one_way.0: That door only opens one way, champ. Win first!
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.no_room.0: No room in your pockets? We'll mail it! We won't.
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.rules.0: House rules: no digging, no building, no pouring.
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.rules.1: House rules: no pearls, no fruit, no funny business.
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.rules.2: Tut tut! The show provides everything.
Into the net! Back to the top!
Bounce! And again, from the start!
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.correct.1: Right you are! Keep it going!
quip.scp_unleashed.scp024.correct.2: Perfect! The audience is on its feet!
prize.scp_unleashed.scp024.doll_hairs.jo: Legal tender in no known economy. Spend it wisely.
prize.scp_unleashed.scp024.dirt.joke: Hand-picked from the finest ground. Probably ground.
prize.scp_unleashed.scp024.stick.joke: Pre-owned by a tree. Lightly used.
prize.scp_unleashed.scp024.seed.joke: Plant it, water it, and in a few weeks you will have a second prize!
prize.scp_unleashed.scp024.dead_bush.jok: Low maintenance. It has already done the hard part.
prize.scp_unleashed.scp024.rotten_flesh: A Lovely Piece of Rotten Flesh
From our very own studio audience. Don't ask which one.
prize.scp_unleashed.scp024.pebble.joke: A shiny little pebble. It's flint. It's a pebble. It's yours!
prize.scp_unleashed.scp024.ribbon.joke: Because you took part! You absolutely took part.

quiz.scp_unleashed.scp024.5.q: What is our most popular prize?
quiz.scp_unleashed.scp024.7.q: How many legs does a spider have?
quiz.scp_unleashed.scp024.9.q: Which block falls when nothing is under it?
quiz.scp_unleashed.scp024.10.q: What is the host holding right now?
quiz.scp_unleashed.scp024.11.q: What grows from a wheat seed?
quiz.scp_unleashed.scp024.12.q: What happens if you lose a game?
quiz.scp_unleashed.scp024.14.q: How many hearts does a full health bar show?
quiz.scp_unleashed.scp024.15.q: What lights up a dark room?

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp024_stage_door: The SCP-024 stage door is a pair of large glass doors with nothing but darkness behind them. It is found on the front of a plain warehouse that appears near a reader of the SCP-024 dossier.
Using the door sends you into the ShowStage, where the host runs you through six random games. Win all six to unlock the exit door. Lose one and you are eliminated.
The door and the whole warehouse cannot be broken by tools, explosions, pistons or fluids. Only commands can remove them.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp024_doll_hairs: Doll Hairs are the favourite prize of the Game Show of Death: a little bundle of doll hair, tied with a pink band.
Win a game in SCP-024 for a chance at one to five of them, or survive all six games for a grand prize of twenty-four. They are useless.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp024_participat: A blue and white rosette awarded by the host of SCP-024 for taking part.
It is a possible prize for any win, and every contestant who survives six games receives one. It does nothing.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp024.2: Six wins to get back out.
